english:
Hurls a spike that bounces off enemies and surfaces, seeking up to 9 enemies within ? meters of each. Hits deal <pve 427 /> <pvp [82] /> damage and <strand Sever /> enemies for ?+? seconds. Damage decreases by 18% on the first bounce and by 42.5% on every bounce afterwards.

The returning spike grants Melee Ability Energy based on the number of hits. Press Melee Attack while it is nearby to catch it and increase the energy gained:
• 0 hits: 5% energy, or 20% if caught
• 1 hit: 10% energy, or 30% if caught
• 2 hits: 20% energy, or 50% if caught
• 3 hits: 30% energy, or 70% if caught
• 4 hits: 35% energy, or 85% if caught
• 5+ hits: 40% energy, or 100% if caught

Catching the spike on a <strand Strand /> subclass also grants <strand Woven Mail /> for 2 seconds per kill scored by the spike, up to 10 seconds.

// The seeking distance, Sever duration, and attribution of the additional unknown duration are unspecified.
